summary: Backend (5/5 pytest) and frontend UI tests all pass. The 3D Mars scene renders correctly with Mars-red terrain, sky gradient, hologram deposit pillars, rover, route trail, and all HUD panels (SOL-WINDOW PLANNER top-left, TELEMETRY top-right, gauges left, SECTOR SCAN radar bottom-right, LAYERS legend bottom-left, PLAY/RESET/FLY controls bottom-center). No __PAYLOAD__ placeholder in HTML. Regenerate endpoint completes in ~15s. Previous washed-out white bug is fixed.
action_items: Minor (non-blocking): Console warning 'THREE.BufferGeometry.computeBoundingSphere(): Computed radius is NaN. The position attribute is likely to have NaN values.' emitted once during iframe load in viz_three.py — some geometry has NaN vertex positions. Scene still renders fine; worth tracking down (likely in terrain wind-streaks, contour overlay, or route tube where sampling could produce NaN when out-of-bounds).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py /api/regenerate has a bare `raise HTTPException` inside except that will lose original exception context — minor.
server.py mars_file endpoint is good (path traversal check present).
Cross-origin canvas readback: iframe served from same backend origin so no CORS issue in production; scene HTML directly loaded works well.
seed_data_creation: None — /app/demo/plan.json regenerated via /api/regenerate endpoint during test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests at /app/backend/tests/test_backend_api.py cover /api/health, /api/plan, /api/mars/plan_three.html, 404 handling, and /api/regenerate (slow ~15-60s). For UI testing the 3D canvas, DO NOT rely on drawImage(canvas) pixel sampling inside iframe — WebGL cross-origin/tainted-canvas returns all-black pixels; instead take a playwright screenshot of the top-level page and visually inspect. All data-testid attributes work: mars-app, status-pill, regenerate-btn, open-tab-btn, scene-iframe.
